userStories.title: Prioritize Unwatched Movies in Dashboard Sorting
acceptanceCriteria: Unwatched movies always appear above watched movies in the Dashboard list/grid
Secondary sorting (e.g., A-Z, Runtime) is applied independently within the 'Unwatched' and 'Watched' groups
Default sorting method for the Dashboard is updated to 'Title (A-Z)' upon first launch
Toggling a movie as 'Watched' immediately moves it to the bottom section while maintaining correct sort order
userStories.notes: UX Improvement - Ensures users see actionable items first

userStories.title: Implement Leaderboard with Tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard view contains a segmented control or tab bar with two options: 'Movies Watched' and 'Correct Predictions'
'Movies Watched' tab displays a list of users ranked by the count/percentage of movies marked as watched
Each row in 'Movies Watched' shows the Username and their Watched Percentage/Count
'Correct Predictions' tab displays a 'Coming Soon' placeholder state (text or graphic)
Data is fetched dynamically from the user/leaderboard backend endpoint

userStories.title: Add Launch Splash Screen
acceptanceCriteria: App launches to a dedicated Splash/Loading View instead of the Login View directly
Splash View performs an authentication check (session validation) in the background
If session is valid, user is navigated to the Dashboard View with a smooth transition
If session is invalid or missing, user is navigated to the Sign In View
Splash screen includes app logo/branding to mask the auth check latency
userStories.notes: UX Improvement - Smoother app entry flow

userStories.title: Secure Logout Redirection
acceptanceCriteria: Logout action clears the local session/token immediately
App navigation stack is reset (popped to root) upon successful logout
User is redirected explicitly to the Sign In View
User cannot navigate back to the Dashboard via the 'Back' button after logging out
userStories.notes: Security/UX - Prevents ghost sessions and navigation errors
